title: Untitled (CDs and Doily)
description: Dense mixed-media collage assembles compact discs, a white lace doily, red ribbon stripes, and iridescent plastic sheeting across a vivid red and blue ground. Multiple cassette-like components and a drawn heart motif are embedded within layered transparent materials and scattered colored rods.
composition: grid of CDs flanking central vertical ribbon columns
keywords: lace doily embedded in plastic sheeting
